headline: Hossam Abdalla: Lists new updates in COPD 2027 (GOLD) on X
dek: The pulmonology and sleep medicine specialist summarised five points he described as new updates in the 2027 GOLD COPD document.
body:
Hossam Abdalla, a pulmonology, critical care and sleep medicine specialist who lists membership of the European Sleep Research Society (ESRS) in his profile, posted a short summary of what he called "New Updates in COPD 2027 (GOLD)" on X.

According to his post, the updates are:

- Pre-COPD and PRISm: people in these categories are described as at risk and to be monitored.
- The fixed ratio of below 0.7 stays, with repetition if the value is between 0.6 and 0.8.
- CT once in every COPD patient, if available.
- Group A: start with a long-acting muscarinic antagonist (LAMA).
- New biologics: astegolimab and tozorakimab.

The post also included two linked images.
key_quote: Group A: start with a LAMA
